d:
Bihar men NDA sarkar ke karyakal ka ek aur parav pura ho raha hai. is bich purv mukhyamantri Nitish Kumar aur maujuda mukhyamantri Samrat Choudhary ke karyakal, phaislon aur rajnitik netritv ki tulna charcha men hai. Nitish Kumar ke lanbe shasan aur Samrat Choudhary ke netritv vali sarkar ki prathmiktaon men kya antar hai? sarkar ki yojnaon, vikas karyon aur rajnitik paristhitiyon ko samjhie.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
